title: Normalize markdown YAML frontmatter

steps.instruction: Read the markdown document. Confirm it opens with a `---` fenced YAML frontmatter block.
steps.checkpoint: The document text is loaded and a frontmatter block is detected at the start.

steps.instruction: Sort the frontmatter keys ascending, emit `key: value` with a single space after the colon, quote only values that require it, and render lists as `  - item` lines. Leave the body after the closing `---` byte-for-byte unchanged.
steps.checkpoint: Keys are sorted; spacing/quoting is canonical; the body after the closing fence is unchanged.
File written; the body bytes after the frontmatter are identical to the input.

input.document:
# Just a heading

No frontmatter here.

antiExamples.why: The document has no frontmatter block; this skill must abstain, never invent one.
Nested maps are outside the supported subset; abstain rather than mangle.

abortConditions: The document does not start with a `---` frontmatter fence.
The frontmatter block is unterminated (no closing `---`).
The frontmatter contains nested maps, multi-line scalars, anchors, or flow maps (outside the supported subset).
